title: Trading Time Seasonality in Commodity Futures: An Opportunity for Arbitrage in the Natural Gas and Crude Oil Markets?
summary: Source uses many identified maturities and monthly averages. Continuous NG/CL or84daily front references cannot reproduce those contracts; move on.
about: Calendar-time seasonality across NG/WTI futures maturities.
findings: Authors report summer price peaks and winter troughs across maturity panels and propose seasonal trades; no replication here.
mechanism: Seasonal hedging preferences/risk compensation are proposed, not measured compulsory orders.
